blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five current views and six poses from the current Blender wear render. The pale jacket remains nearly featureless: the diagonal front treatment reads as thin piping, not a fastened plastron; elbow quilting and rear waist adjustment are not visibly constructed.
Strong irregular faceting and wrinkling remain over both sleeves, with pronounced bunching around the upper arm/underarm in arms-up and arm-cross. Sleeve surface quality is not acceptable.

The skirt flares but does not read as controlled, ordered pleats; folds are uneven. The shorts render as broad, blunt thigh tubes with visible avatar gaps and large exposed sections at crouch and sit. Coverage and pose deformation are not acceptable.

The neckline is a narrow open tube rather than a finished fencing collar. The thin diagonal line does not fasten or retain the overlapping front panels. Neck clearance and garment retention remain unverified.
These are Blender prototype renders only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted weight deformation, Unity import, VRChat Build & Test, and SDK upload remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
